in_hebrew.name: Marleah
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Marla + Ah, meaning 'little shepherdess'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Marleah הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Marla, meaning 'rebellious' or 'little rebel'. The suffix Ah, meaning 'god' or 'shepherd', turns the name into a sweet and nurturing title for a little girl, signifying a caretaker or protector. In biblical tradition, Marleah can be connected to the shepherd girl Rachel, who tended the flocks and cared for her family.
